title: The canonical coherent source comparison of the whole point quotient tower
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, let l be prime with l unequal to D.p, and let E be a finite extension of the l-adic rationals [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. On s=Spec D.k, use the strict quotient tower constructions and the CoherentSourceComparison predicate of [def-trf-point-quotient-tower-data]. Suppose for every n a ring isomorphism q_n identifies the n+1st adic quotient of the lifted integral coefficient ring with the lifted quotient coefficient ring and sends the quotient class of x to the lifted quotient class of x.down. Suppose e identifies its completed ring sheaf with the detailed completed integral coefficient sheaf and commutes with all quotient projections through the level isomorphisms induced by q [lem-weil-pbc-integral-coefficient-presentation-comparison]. Then CoherentSourceComparison D l E q e holds: every flat-term K-flat complex P has a strict tower isomorphism r from its presented ordinary tower to sourceSheafTower(P), sending b tensor x to the nth level coefficient image of b tensor x. There is an isomorphism gamma from exact sections of the transported entire derived coherent tower of [P] to [source(P)]. Its homomorphism is exactly the literal composite of the canonical coherent-tower counit, the exact restriction and sections factorization maps, and the localized image of r. This is an isomorphism of whole diagrams, before evaluation.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized strict isomorphism r from strictPresentationComparison. Restrict P along e and apply pbcIsoRestriction_isKFlat to its K-flat certificate. The already proved towerCounit_isIso makes the actual canonical coherent tower counit invertible on this representative. Map the exact restriction localization factor through completedReductionTower and compose with that counit. Map through exact restriction and sections, then compose with their canonical factorization isomorphisms and the localized image of r. All factors are invertible. The homomorphism is definitionally the literal composite in CoherentSourceComparison, proved by reflexivity. This applies to zero and unbounded complexes and retains the whole diagram.

theorem coherentSource (_hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    ∀ q : ∀ n : ℕ, PbcIntegralRing l E ⧸ (pbcIntegralDatum l E).ideal ^ (n + 1) ≃+*
        ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : PbcIntegralRing l E), q n (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) =
        ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x.down)) →
      ∀ e : pbcAdicCompletion (Spec (.of D.k)) (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ≅
          completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E (Spec (.of D.k)),
        (∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E
            (Spec (.of D.k)) n =
          pbcAdicProjection (Spec (.of D.k)) (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ≫
            (IntegralCoefficientPresentation.level l E (Spec (.of D.k)) q n).hom) →
        CoherentSourceComparison D l E q e
